data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in the net provision for claims includes a deterioration of ($10,253,290) in respect of claims outstanding at the previous year end (2021: deterioration $13,653,294). The deterioration comprises net claims including the change in claims incurred but not reported ('IBNR').
data.standardized_narrative: Using the gross claims development table (gross triangle) the syndicate shows a net favourable prior-year release of approximately $39.39m (about 3.7% of opening gross claims outstanding), driven by favourable development across several older underwriting years (2013-2020) primarily via reductions in IBNR and older case estimates. The managing agent however reports a net deterioration of $10.253m in the net provision for claims (after reinsurance), indicating that adverse movement in reinsurers' share or other netting effects partly offset the gross releases. The report highlights IBNR movements and the heightened inflationary environment as material influences on claims liabilities.

Future economic and social inflation are a material component due to the heightened inflation environment.
data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year movement was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (pages 34-35) by comparing the current estimate to the previous diagonal for underwriting years 2013-2020, producing a gross release of $39.39m. The report text contains an explicit net deterioration of $10.253m (net of reinsurance); a gross movement by note was not explicitly stated. Triangle numbers are presented in thousands (USD 000). The gross triangle excludes the '2012 & prior' aggregate column from the diagonal calculation per methodology rules.
